Module.doc: Registration record for a virtual-table module. Carries the named callback set described in master.md's Module-shape table. Targets render as a struct of function pointers (C), a trait object + vtable (Rust), a class satisfying a structural protocol (Python), or equivalent. Optional callbacks (xBegin/xSync/xCommit/xRollback/xRename/xSavepoint/xRelease/xRollbackTo) are admitted as 'present-or-absent'; absence makes the corresponding SQL action a no-op or ReadOnly rejection (Pin 22). The xUpdate callback is required for writable modules; its absence rejects all DML with VtabCondition::ReadOnly.

VtabHandle.doc: Per-instance state owned by a Module. Created by xCreate / xConnect, retired by xDestroy / xDisconnect. The framework holds it by value and threads it back into every vtab callback; it never inspects the contents.

CursorHandle.doc: Per-cursor state owned by a Module. Created by xOpen, retired by xClose. Distinct from /parts/storage::CursorHandle (which is a btree cursor). One Vtab may have multiple concurrent cursors (Pin 10).

ConstraintOp.doc: Comparison operators a vtab's xBestIndex may negotiate. The set is closed; new operators require a spec change. Pin 26: where-terms whose operator is outside this set are NOT exposed to xBestIndex; they become post-filter predicates the VDBE re-checks after xColumn.

Constraint.doc: A single WHERE constraint exposed to xBestIndex. column = -1 denotes the rowid column. usable = false means the constraint cannot be honored on this iteration (Pin 5); a module that assigns argv_index to an unusable constraint has its assignment ignored.

OrderBy.doc: A single ORDER BY clause fragment exposed to xBestIndex. column = -1 denotes the rowid column. desc = true if DESC.

ConstraintUsage.doc: Per-constraint reply from xBestIndex. argv_index is 1-based and dense (Pin 6); 0 means the constraint is unused. nonzero k means the constraint's right-hand side is delivered to xFilter as argv[k - 1]. omit = true asserts xFilter will fully honor the constraint, so the VDBE need not re-check it post-materialize (Pin 7).

IndexInfo.doc: Negotiation record passed to xBestIndex. The framework constructs it with constraints + order_by + a default usage vector (every entry argv_index=0, omit=false), then hands it to the module mutably. The module sets idx_num, idx_str, order_by_consumed, estimated_cost, and per-constraint usage. Post-call the framework treats those fields as the negotiated plan and does NOT mutate them further (Pin 4). idx_str ownership: the module owns the string for the cursor's lifetime; target mappings declare any free callback (Pin 27).

VtabUpdateOp.doc: Inferred from xUpdate's argv shape (Pins 14-17). Delete: argc==1, argv[0] is old rowid. Insert: argc>1 and argv[0]==Null. UpdateInPlace: argc>1, argv[0]==argv[1], both non-Null. RenameRowid: argc>1, argv[0]!=argv[1], both non-Null. The framework does not eagerly tag argv with this variant; it is a documentation aid for module authors and the per-target dispatcher.

VtabCondition.doc: Error conditions raised by vtab callbacks and the framework. Targets render as their canonical sum-of-errors. Internal carries a free-form detail string for module-specific failures the framework cannot classify.
